title: pseudognaphalium oxyphyllum
intro: Pseudognaphalium oxyphyllum, commonly known as Rabbit's tobacco or Western rabbit tobacco, is a flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pseudognaphalium oxyphyllum include wound healing, skin protection, and the treatment of infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its effectiveness and potential side effects.
